column1: # Tamagi — catalog of everything optional (`tamagi install`, first login).
# Native layers (systemd-sysext) cover drivers, ROCm, Bazzite gaming, hardware
# monitors, and system tools that perform best outside Flatpak/containers.
# Format: id <TAB> category <TAB> size <TAB> action <TAB> description

column5: Opera GX (Flatpak)
Google Chrome (Flatpak)
Vivaldi (Flatpak)
Firefox — Mozilla's browser (Flatpak)
WhatsApp — web app in its own window, opened by your Chromium-based browser
Lark Suite — native Linux RPM in a reversible layer (WebApp already pre-installed)
Virtual machines — Cockpit Machines with KVM, UEFI, TPM and SPICE, built into the image (turns on its services)
Windows 11 in a container (dockur/windows)
Steam (RPM Fusion), native like on Bazzite — gamescope, MangoHud, GameMode and 32-bit Mesa/Vulkan are already built in (asks for the password)

Wine + Winetricks, native (asks for the password)
GOverlay + vkBasalt, native (asks for the password)
Protontricks, native (asks for the password)
